verdict.rationale: Skills are built to be driven by natural language: Claude loads a skill when its description matches the request, and skill-creator lets users create and improve skills conversationally (docs-2, docs-25, docs-32, docs-13, docs-30). Hands-on reports show implicit triggering is unreliable. One cited eval found skills never invoked in 56% of cases, and users often must name the skill explicitly or fall back to `/skill-name` (comm-12, comm-13, comm-14). missing for 10: reliable automatic invocation from ordinary natural-language requests, independent corroboration that natural-language triggering works consistently.
